Julie (PM): Ok team — we need a concrete cut for the next milestone. Proposal: ship an MVP that enables customer pilots for the core inference surface (text gen + streaming) but defer multi-tenant routing & advanced routing rules to v1. Thoughts?
Mike (Eng): +1 to narrowing scope. Routing is a big lift and blocks infra work.
Sara (Designer): Agree, UX for tenant settings can be polished in v1. For pilots we can do a simple admin toggle.
Tomas (QA): What's the acceptance criteria for the pilot? Need clear gating metrics before we call it shipped.
Julie (PM): Good call. Draft gate checklist:
```
MVP Pilot Gate Checklist
- Feature surface: text generation + streaming + basic rate limits
- Latency: p95 < 300ms on pilot baseline traffic
- Error rate: < 1% 5xx for pilot endpoints
- Cost baseline: token cost within 15% of estimate
- Observability: per-route tracing + token-level cost metrics enabled
- Customer sign-off: 2 pilot customers have completed acceptance tests
- Rollout plan: canary at 5% traffic with automatic rollback
```
Mike (Eng): p95 300ms is doable if we limit max seq to 1024 and enable prefix caching. We'll need a temporary config to force smaller KV cache for pilots.
Ravi (SRE): Canary + rollback is non-negotiable. I'll wire a circuit that drops to fallback-hosted-model on latency spikes.
Tomas (QA): For customer acceptance tests I want 8 smoke tests + 3 perf scenarios. I'll post the test matrix by EOD.
Julie (PM): Timeline: If we commit to this cut, target pilot-ready in 3 weeks. If we try to include routing, it adds ~2–3 weeks and risks slipping. Decision: accept scope cut or accept a 3-week delay.
Sara (Designer): Can we do a tiny admin UX for tenant toggles so pilots feel safe? Minimal: a read-only settings page plus invite-only flag.
Mike (Eng): That seems low-effort. I can scaffold the admin flag in a day and wire it to routing layer to just default to single-tenant path.
Julie (PM): Ok — plan B (if infra finds a blocker): do an internal dogfood pilot first (internal customers) and push external pilot 1 week later. Prefer external pilots first though.
Ravi (SRE): I'll add SLO alerts for pilot orgs and create a runbook for failover.
Tomas (QA): One more gate to add: regression check against current hosted API for tokenization parity + sample prompts. No surprises on output.
Mike (Eng): Noted. We'll run regression harness against latest model snapshots.
Julie (PM): Owner list: Julie = product / customer comms; Mike = infra + rollout; Ravi = SRE / runbook; Tomas = QA matrix; Sara = pilot UX.
Sara (Designer): I'll drop a mock of the admin toggle in #design by lunchtime.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary window 2026-04-08 14:00 UTC -> 2026-04-08 18:00 UTC (tentative).
Mike (Eng): Quick ask — can we soften the default token limit to 512 for pilots? halves perf tail risk.
Julie (PM): Fine, set pilot default seq=512, but document that it differs from prod v1 behavior. Put in the release notes.
Tomas (QA): I'll include a test that validates behavior at seq=512 vs seq=1024 for parity notes.
Ravi (SRE): For rollback, prefer model-variant fallback over full endpoint disable. Less customer-visible.
Julie (PM): Sounds good. Final ask: Mike, confirm infra impact + whether any infra PRs block the 3-week target by EOD. If not, we cut routing and proceed. If yes, we'll escalate.
Mike (Eng): Will confirm. :eyes:
Sara (Designer): :thumbsup:
Tomas (QA): I'll post the test matrix in this thread when ready.
Julie (PM): Thanks everyone — I'll update the milestone tracker and ping stakeholders after Mike confirms.
